negotiation-body: Request any public HTML page with Accept: text/markdown to receive a Markdown representation of that URL. Responses include Vary: Accept, Accept-Encoding so CDNs cache HTML and Markdown separately.
errors-body: API routes return structured JSON errors with code, message, status, and hint fields. Unknown /api paths return HTTP 404 JSON.
